scope: Source-verified functional polarity and viewer semantics only. Frozen BA02 geometry, archive, source names and placement are unchanged.

source.view: Top plan view, positive mark at drawing-left and negative mark at drawing-right.
source.inspection: Official PDF hash checked and rendered marks visually inspected on 2026-10-09. Vendor document/image is not included in this package.

datum.frame: BA02 source CAD frame C, millimetres, Z up; GLB stores metres.
datum.terminal_top_z_scope: Preserved frozen BA02 conservative reservation height, not a new source-hardware or current-drawing height qualification.
datum.terminal_position_note: Use frozen symmetric 550.5 mm pitch / 2 = 275.25 mm. The source 48.5 mm end offset is rounded, differing by 0.05 mm; this correction does not rebuild geometry.

derivation: Drawing fitting offset from center = 376.3 - 647.6 / 2 = +52.5 mm, toward drawing-right.
Frozen BA02 fitting center is Y -52.5 mm. Therefore drawing-right maps to CAD -Y.
Positive mark is on drawing-left, so installed positive is Y +275.25 mm. Negative mark is on drawing-right, so installed negative is Y -275.25 mm.
Terminal depth offset gives X = cx - (161.5 / 2 - 26.7) = cx - 54.05 mm. Z 169.6 mm is preserved from frozen BA02.
Legacy node names assigned the opposite polarity. Resolve source aliases and use this source-verified functional map; cable continuity is not polarity evidence.

viewer_colors.scope: Semantic visualization colors selected for this correction; no assertion about physical terminal coating or insulation color.

runtime_policy.material_isolation: Clone every corrected mesh material. Never recolor a shared original metal material.
